headline: Brazil October Inflation Slows to 0.32%, Below Forecasts
summary: Brazil's consumer inflation slowed to 0.32% in October, coming in below consensus market forecasts.
why: Inflation figures dictate monetary policy decisions by Banco Central do Brasil, influencing local lending rates and the valuation of the Brazilian real.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Lower-than-expected inflation eases pressure on the central bank to maintain aggressive monetary tightening.

why_moved: Cooling inflation prints reduced expectations for further interest rate hikes, impacting currency and fixed-income assets.
